sense: fashion; elegance in dress and looks

terms.comment: novissimō modō, in the latest style (Traupman 160).

evidence: Cic. de Or. 1.5; Tac. Ann. 14.19 (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: go out of use; go out of fashion
evidence: Traupman 118, 387: go out of style, exolēscō

phrases.latin: sīc aequātō omnium cultū quid ūnaquaeque vestrum verētur nē in sē cōnspiciātur?
phrases.english: if all of you dress alike, what is any one of you afraid will be noticed in her?

sources: Lewis & Short: cultus · Lewis & Short: modus · Lewis & Short: elegantia · Lewis & Short: exolesco
